rows.label: bf04280100_0010
rows.name: So, we meet again, Heaven's Holy Grail!

rows.label: bf04280100_0020
rows.name: Oh, Turtle-chan.

rows.label: bf04280100_0030
rows.name:
Yeah! Wait, who are you
calling "Turtle-chan?"

rows.label: bf04280100_0040
rows.name:
Playing along, then correcting it—
comedy 101, right?

rows.label: bf04280100_0050
rows.name: My name is Zeke B Ultimate Genbu-sama!

rows.label: bf04280100_0052
rows.name: Remember it properly, you fool!

rows.label: bf04280100_0060
rows.name:
That's too long! And what's
with this 'Ultimate' thing?

rows.label: bf04280100_0070
rows.name:
Last time I couldn't see my surroundings well
and got caught off guard, but...

rows.label: bf04280100_0075
rows.name: Today we're on nice solid ground!

rows.label: bf04280100_0080
rows.name:
If you think you can run from me a
second time, you are quite mistaken!

rows.label: bf04280100_0090
rows.name:
I wasn't running away...
And anyway, Turtle-chan?

rows.label: bf04280100_0100
rows.name: What is it?

rows.label: bf04280100_0110
rows.name: You just answered to it...

rows.label: bf04280100_0120
rows.name: I've been wondering for a while now...

rows.label: bf04280100_0122
rows.name:
What's with that
turtle-patterned eye patch?

rows.label: bf04280100_0130
rows.name: Heh, good eye.

rows.label: bf04280100_0140
rows.name:
This is... the legendary eye that
pierces darkness and banishes evil...

rows.label: bf04280100_0142
rows.name: The Overlord's Mind's Eye!

rows.label: bf04280100_0150
rows.name:
It's super powerful, so I don't whip
it out for every little thing.

rows.label: bf04280100_0160
rows.name:
I mean, if I released it, you'd
all vanish in an instant, y'know?

rows.label: bf04280100_0170
rows.name: Oh, so it's an evil eye.

rows.label: bf04280100_0180
rows.name:
By the way, it's not because he can't afford
a contact lens for his left eye, okay?!

rows.label: bf04280100_0190
rows.name:
Then just buy both of them.
Wait... you're nearsighted?!

rows.label: bf04280100_0200
rows.name: By the way, what business brings you here today?

rows.label: bf04280100_0210
rows.name:
Are you stupid? It's about
Heaven's Holy Grail, obviously!

rows.label: bf04280100_0220
rows.name: Listen, we don't have time to deal with you.

rows.label: bf04280100_0230
rows.name: Now, shoo, shoo!

rows.label: bf04280100_0240
rows.name: What's this?

rows.label: bf04280100_0243
rows.name:
Did our fighting spirit scare you into
wetting yourself, cat girl?

rows.label: bf04280100_0250
rows.name: What?! Who'd wet themselves?!

rows.label: bf04280100_0252
rows.name: You turtle head!

rows.label: bf04280100_0260
rows.name:
N-Nia? Calling someone
'turtle head' is a bit...

rows.label: bf04280100_0270
rows.name: Huh?! Why?

rows.label: bf04280100_0280
rows.name: Why?!

rows.label: bf04280100_0282
rows.name:
It's, ah... Hikari,
why are you blushing?

rows.label: bf04280100_0290
rows.name: Idiot!
